Projectile Motion with Linear Drag The main force affecting the motion of a projectile, other than gravity, is air resistance. This slowing down force is drag force, and it acts in a direction opposite to the velocity of the projectile (see accompany- ing figure). For projectiles moving through the air at relatively low speeds, however, the drag force is (very nearly) proportional to the speed (to the first power) and so is called linear.
